name: Detonate

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: A visible creature makes a Constitution save against 10d10 Fire, half on success. Other creatures in a 60-foot Emanation around it save Dexterity against another 10d10 Fire, half on success; they save with Disadvantage if the initial target dropped to 0 HP. Unattended nonmagical objects in the blast also take damage and flammable ones ignite.
